documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On September 25, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Fixation Of Record Date Under Regulation 42 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a turnover of 700 crores for Q1 FY27, achieving an EBITDA margin of 5.43%. Management noted that while volume growth was impacted by trade route disruptions in the first two months, operations normalized in June. The company is undergoing a restructuring process to demerge its copper business into a new subsidiary, Tieramet Limited. Management maintains a positive outlook, targeting 12-15% volume growth for the year and continuing to focus on increasing the share of value-added products. Bhagyanagar India Limited reported record financial performance for FY26, crossing 2,000 crores in revenue and 50 crores in PAT.

guidance.claim: The company targets an EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% for the remainder of the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: Management expects export contribution to be between 12% and 15% for the year.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: The company aims to reach 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: The company aims to double its turnover to 5,000 crores within the next three years.
guidance.quote: We are, in 5 years, we are planning to... 3 years, and we are planning to double the turnover to 5,000 crores, which translates in Between 20% to 25% CAGR.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 25% CAGR for the next three to four years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects a minimum annual volume growth of 15% to 20%.
guidance.quote: Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

guidance.claim: Management is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: The company plans to increase the share of value-added products to 66% by the end of next year.
guidance.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observes strong demand from existing customers who are planning to double their capacity in the next three years.
demand_outlook.quote: All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The secondary copper market in India is projected to grow at a CAGR of 12-13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy in the world.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Global copper consumption is predicted to double to 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has proposed a capex of 40 crores over FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: A capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 metric tons is expected to be operational by June of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has proposed a capital expenditure of 40 crores over the next two years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to invest 10 crores into a plastic recycling project to process cable waste.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding recycling verticals for both aluminium and plastic.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are also adding recycling verticals of aluminium and plastic.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA margin of 5.43% and PAT margin of 2.87% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA per kg of 62 rupees in the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: Silver-plated and tin-plated bus bars for data centers are expected to yield approximately 10% EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: So, we are, this product will give us roughly about 10%, EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company uses a pass-through mechanism to transfer copper price fluctuations to finished products.
margins_costs.quote: We have a pass-through mechanism of the copper prices to the finished products.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that pure recycling companies in the industry typically maintain EBITDA margins over 5%.
margins_costs.quote: And if you look at my other peers who are already in recycling, they are already having EBITDA margins of over 5%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved sales volumes of 5,200 tons in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We have achieved sales volumes of 5,200 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has completed an expansion to reach an installed capacity of 35,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's manufacturing capacity has reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume grew by 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes in the last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains relationships with over 500 clients across various sectors.
orders_capacity.quote: We have 500-plus clients with enduring relationships of over 30 years.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is raising 150 crores in total, with the first tranche of 52 crores expected in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: Management projects debt levels to be between 300 and 350 crores by 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is in the process of demerging into separate copper and real estate verticals.
capital_allocation.quote: And, once... because all the approvals have been taken, now the matter has been listed for hearing by the Honorable NCLT on 9 June, before which time we need to obtain no-objection certificates from the Register of Companies, Regional Director, Official Liquidator, and the income tax authorities.

capital_allocation.claim: The increase in total equity was driven by retained earnings rather than dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital increased to 230 crores, which management stated is proportional to revenue growth.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores. And this increase in working capital is proportional to our revenue, so there's no, no reason to be concerned.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management expects Q1 volumes might be marginally lower than Q4 due to sourcing delays.
risks_headwinds.quote: Having said that, I do see that in the first quarter, my volume might be slightly lower than the fourth quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company anticipates a significant copper shortage starting in three to four years.
risks_headwinds.quote: But we foresee a big shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global copper ore quality is declining, which impacts primary production.
risks_headwinds.quote: So this trend is going to continue, especially because the ore qualities across the world is coming down.

management_commitments.claim: Complete digital transformation of the company processes and reporting.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: Complete the restructuring and demerger of the copper business.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, the NCLT hearing is scheduled for the 7th of August, after which we should soon be able to complete this restructuring.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach a turnover of 5,000 crores.
management_commitments.quote: The Demerge Company, which will have only the copper business, will reach 5,000 crores in 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to invest 40 crores in capacities and new ventures.
management_commitments.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to increase value-added products to 66% of the mix.
management_commitments.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to complete a fundraise of roughly 150 crores.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to maintain a 5% EBITDA margin.
management_commitments.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.
